{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for Inception Mercury: renders the diffusion denoising stream live inside the answer bubble","id":"gh:1427046181","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-mercury-diffusion","slug":"TonyWu2333/dsh-mercury-diffusion","topics":["deepseek-harness","diffusion-llm","dsh-plugin","mercury"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin for Inception Mercury: renders the diffusion denoising stream live ins"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ide the answer bubble"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-mercury-diffusion"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**Watch a diffusion LLM think — live, inside your DeepSeek Harness chat.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) plugin that streams the real denoising frames of Inception Mercury and play"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"s them in the answer bubble, from noise to finished text."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English · 简体中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Promo video"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Highlights"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Real frames, not a fake animation.** Every frame is a denoising state returned by the Mercury AP"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"I (`diffusing: true`), replayed at a readable pace.
- **Works with the provider route you already ha"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"ve.** The plugin registers no provider and no settings page of its own; it adds a diffusion layer un"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"der the route you add on dsh's Models page.
- **Zero-cost capability probe.** Whether a route/model "},{"id":"p8s5","text":"honors `diffusing` is measured with a request that is rejected before any token is generated. No mod"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"el-name guessing, no billed tokens.
- **Never breaks a conversation.** Attachments, auxiliary calls,"},{"id":"p8s7","text":" unwatched sessions, routes without a credential, or a gateway that rejects the field all fall back "},{"id":"p8s8","text":"to the original adapter untouched.
- **Clean session logs.** Intermediate frames travel on a side ch"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"annel; only the converged text is written to the log and shown to the model.
- **One-click toggle pe"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"r model.** A small floating button appears for capable models; your choice is stored in dsh user set"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"tings (plugin config key `diffusion.<provider>::<model>`) and survives restarts."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**Requirements:** dsh `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`, Node `^22.19 || >=24`, and `pnpm` on your `PATH` (`dsh "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"plugin` uses it to manage profile plugins)."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 1. Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Install from source instead"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 2. Add an Inception route"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Open **Settings → Models → Add model provider → Custom model API** and fill in:"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Field | Value |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"| Provider ID | `inception` |
| Display name | `Inception` |
| Base URL | `https://api.inceptionlabs"},{"id":"p18s2","text":".ai/v1` (must include `/v1`) |
| API protocol | OpenAI Chat Completions |
| API key | your Inception"},{"id":"p18s3","text":" API key |
| Models | **Add model** → `mercury-3` (or `mercury-2.5`, `mercury-2`) |"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Then click **Create provider**."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"> [!WARNING]
> Don't point the built-in **DeepSeek** card at Inception. That adapter speaks a differ"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"ent protocol, and requests fail with `404`."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Prefer config files? Add the route to cordis.patch.yml"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Use the bare model id (`mercury-3`) when calling Inception directly. Gateways that aggregate provide"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"rs usually expect the prefixed form (`inception/mercury-3`)."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### 3. Turn it on"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Pick the Mercury model from the model selector next to the send button and start a new conversation."},{"id":"p25s2","text":" A floating button appears on the right edge; switch diffusion **on** and send a message."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"Design notes"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- **Frames never enter the session log or the model's context.** dsh's `StreamChunk` protocol only a"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"ppends `text-delta`, while a diffusion frame replaces the whole text. Frames therefore travel on a s"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"ide channel, and only the converged text is persisted as a normal assistant message, which keeps dsh"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"'s "model-visible ⟺ logged" invariant.
- **`diffusing` is requested only while a browser is watching"},{"id":"p29s5","text":".** The floating button component also holds the frame subscription, which is the "someone is watchi"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"ng" signal. Title generation, compaction, and headless/ACP runs always use plain incremental streami"},{"id":"p29s7","text":"ng.
- **Capability is probed, not inferred.** On entering a conversation, the plugin sends `messages"},{"id":"p29s8","text":": []` with `diffusing` set to an invalid type. Validation rejects it with `400` before generation; o"},{"id":"p29s9","text":"nly a server that knows the field also reports a type error at `loc: ["body","diffusing"]`. The verd"},{"id":"p29s10","text":"ict (`yes` / `no` / `unknown`) is cached per `provider::model` in the process; `unknown` is kept for"},{"id":"p29s11","text":" 60 seconds only.
- **Only faithful re-sends are bridged.** Images or files, auxiliary calls, unwatc"},{"id":"p29s12","text":"hed sessions, and disabled models go to the original adapter. If the gateway rejects `diffusing` bef"},{"id":"p29s13","text":"ore the first frame, the request falls back too. A user abort ends the turn instead of re-sending on"},{"id":"p29s14","text":" an aborted signal.
- **Only the diffusion flag is added.** Gateway reasoning-effort vocabularies (`"},{"id":"p29s15","text":"max` / `xhigh`) and temperature ranges differ from Inception's, so the bridge drops `reasoningEffort"},{"id":"p29s16","text":"` and `temperature` and adds `diffusing: true`. `max_completion_tokens`, `stop`, and tools are forwa"},{"id":"p29s17","text":"rded.
- **Paced playback.** A Mercury answer usually has only 5–10 frames, often arriving together, "},{"id":"p29s18","text":"so the browser shows each frame for at least 180 ms and holds the converged text for 400 ms before s"},{"id":"p29s19","text":"wapping in Markdown.
- **Bubble claiming.** One diffusion attempt binds to exactly one bubble: the o"},{"id":"p29s20","text":"ne being generated, or the one whose text equals the final frame. In multi-step turns a later bubble"},{"id":"p29s21","text":" never steals an earlier one's animation.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Upgrading from 0.1.x"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Troubleshooting"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"| Symptom | Likely cause |"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| `DeepSeek Messages request failed (404)` | The Inception URL was entered on the built-in DeepSeek "},{"id":"p34s2","text":"card. Add a **Custom model API** route instead. |
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"- Inception documents diffusion frames for **text** only. Whether tool-call arguments arrive as delt"},{"id":"p36s2","text":"as or full snapshots in diffusion mode is undocumented; the bridge keeps both forms and picks the on"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"e that parses as JSON at the end. This has not been verified against the real API.
- Playback uses r"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"eal frames, so the frame count is up to the model: typically 5–10 frames, about 1–2 seconds of anima"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"tion. Inception's website uses a fixed 1.5-second front-end animation.
- There are no browser-side s"},{"id":"p36s6","text":"ettings: dsh browser plugins can't read `cordis.yml`, so playback pacing and reconnect backoff are c"},{"id":"p36s7","text":"onstants in code.
- Inception's free tier may be rate-limited at peak times ("free tier is at capaci"},{"id":"p36s8","text":"ty"); dsh retries automatically and playback resumes on success.
- Mercury accepts text input only. "},{"id":"p36s9","text":"dsh turns images into text placeholders, and turns with images or files are not bridged.
- Bridged r"},{"id":"p36s10","text":"equests don't forward `reasoningEffort` or `temperature` (see design notes)."}],"truncated":true}
